title: 第7章 冰帝
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
看着那个年轻的老师，林夕愣了一下神，随即冲上前站在年轻老师身侧，一剑一个将即将冲上来的丧尸尽数斩杀。看着突然冲出来一剑一个干净利落的林夕，年轻老师愣了一下。...

林夕开口说道：“他们现在已经不是你的学生了，如果你再手下留情，迎接你的只有死亡。”

说完林夕便往前走去。年轻老师看着林夕的背影，咬了咬嘴唇随后跟着林夕向丧尸迎去。

林夕挥剑斩杀一个后，一个体型矮小的丧尸钻了空子，跑到了林夕的脚下，张开嘴刚想咬下去，此时林夕也发现了，一个后撤步，刚想举剑斩杀的时候，一个尖锐的冰锥直直的刺入矮小丧尸的眼中。林夕看着冰锥，回头看了一眼年轻老师，对年轻老师比了个大拇指，随后接着冲杀过去。不一会在林夕和年轻老师的配合下，原本二十几只丧尸尽数被斩杀，所有逃跑的学生都默默的躲在了两人的身后。

林夕回头看了一眼说道：“去一楼找张常。”众学生没有听林夕的话反而扭头看向年轻老师

年轻老师点了点头说道：“听他的。”林夕看到此情此景也就没有在说什么，而是准备继续向3楼走去，就在这时年轻老师喊住林夕：“同学你好，你要干嘛去？”

林夕说道：“去三楼。”年轻老师疑惑的问道：“三楼班级更多，很危险。”林夕点了点头说道：“你不觉得很奇怪吗，刚才那么大的动静，就只有二楼这几十只而已，如果按你说的三楼有很多，那为什么听到声音他们会不下来？”年轻老师沉思了一下觉得林夕说的有道理点了点头说道：“那我跟你一起去吧，跟你还能有个照应。”林夕心想这不正合我意见随即点了点头。年轻老师对着林夕说道：“那你稍微等我一下，我把他们送下去安顿好。”林夕点了点头没有说话。

年轻老师带着那十几个学生慢慢的向楼下走去，林夕推开一间教室，坐在了其中的一个椅子上，闭目养神了起来。心中暗暗想道：“根据上一世后期的统计，大规模爆发丧尸以及大规模出现异能者就是在刚开始的几天，也就是说如果可能的话我可以尽可能的多找一些刚觉醒的人，建立一个属于自己的根据地。”就在林夕想着的时候，突然系统提示音又响了起来

“长久任务找齐10位能力者”

“任务成功奖励大型防御措施设计图纸”

“任务失败惩罚无”

林夕听着系统的声音惊讶的说道：“我的天，系统你终于良心了一回，没有惩罚了。”

突然听到门外有动静，林夕下意识的拿起寒月指着门口的方向

门外传来年轻老师的声音：“同学，你在里面吗？”

一听是年轻老师的声音，林夕便走了出来，年轻老师看着林夕走出来了便说道：“同学你好，我是刚刚转来咱们学校的老师，我叫孙悦，你呢？”

林夕听到名字以后瞬间呆住了紧接着问道：“你说你叫什么？”

孙悦看着林夕疑惑的回答道：“我叫孙悦啊，怎么了？”“是哪两个字？”“孙子兵法的孙，愉悦的悦。”

林夕不可置信的看着眼前这名长相异常甜美的年轻老师，因为上一世，在华夏最大的根据地，炎黄根据地内，便有着五皇三帝作为根据地的最大靠山，传闻五皇的实力均为S级能力者，而三帝则是S+级能力者，相传三帝之一的冰帝孙悦无限接近于SS级被称为三帝之首。

林夕万万没想到日后三帝之首的冰帝孙悦居然就是自己学校的一名老师。更没想到的是系统居然让林夕将她收到自己的阵营之下。

林夕缓了好半天才说道：“没事没事，我叫林夕，是高三（2）班的学生。”

孙悦点了点头说道：“那我们现在走吧？”“嗯，走吧”

说罢二人便悄悄地往三楼摸去，到达三楼以后二人发现三楼居然一个丧尸也没有，林夕也没有听到任何的声音，孙悦说道：“怎么会是空的呢？”林夕摇了摇头说道：“我也不知道，总感觉哪里不对劲。”说完停顿了一下猛然想到了什么。

林夕脑海中：“我真蠢，怎么把这个忘记了。”
content_en:
Looking at the young teacher, Lin Xi was stunned for a moment, then rushed forward and stood beside the young teacher, killing all the zombies that were about to rush forward one by one with one sword.Seeing Lin Xi who suddenly rushed out and struck out with a clean sword, the young teacher was stunned for a moment....

Lin Xi said: "They are no longer your students. If you continue to show mercy, you will only die."

After saying that, Lin Xi walked forward.The young teacher looked at Lin Xi's back, bit his lip, and then followed Lin Xi toward the zombies.

After Lin Xi swung his sword to kill one, a short zombie took advantage of the opportunity and ran to Lin Xi's feet. He opened his mouth and was about to bite it. At this time, Lin Xi also noticed it. He stepped back. Just when he was about to raise his sword to kill, a sharp ice pick pierced the short zombie's eyes.Lin Xi looked at the ice pick, looked back at the young teacher, gave the young teacher a thumbs up, and then rushed over.After a while, with the cooperation of Lin Xi and the young teacher, all the twenty zombies were killed, and all the students who escaped silently hid behind the two.

Lin Xi looked back and said, "Go to the first floor to find Zhang Chang." The students did not listen to Lin Xi's words and instead turned to look at the young teacher.

The young teacher nodded and said, "Listen to him." Lin Xi didn't say anything when he saw this scene, but was about to continue walking to the third floor. At this moment, the young teacher called Lin Xi: "Hello, classmate, what are you going to do?"

Lin Xi said: "Go to the third floor." The young teacher asked doubtfully: "There are more classes on the third floor, which is very dangerous." Lin Xi nodded and said: "Don't you think it's strange? The big movement just now was only a few dozen on the second floor. If you go by the third floor as you said,There are a lot of them, so why don't they come down when they hear the sound?" The young teacher thought for a moment and felt that what Lin Xi said made sense and nodded, "Then I'll go with you.I can still take care of you." Lin Xi thought that this was not in line with my opinion and nodded.The young teacher said to Lin Xi, "Then wait for me for a moment and I'll send them down to settle down." Lin Xi nodded and said nothing.

The young teacher led the dozen or so students slowly downstairs. Lin Xi pushed open a classroom, sat on one of the chairs, closed her eyes and rested.He secretly thought to himself: "According to statistics from the late period of the last life, large-scale zombie outbreaks and large-scale emergence of superpowers occurred in the first few days. In other words, if possible, I can find as many people who have just awakened as possible and establish a base of my own." Just as Lin Xi was thinking about it, the system prompt sounded again.

"Long-term mission to find 10 ability users"

"Mission success rewards large-scale defense measure design drawings"

"No penalty for mission failure"

Lin Xi was surprised when she heard the system's voice and said, "Oh my god, system, you finally have a conscience and there is no punishment."

Suddenly hearing movement outside the door, Lin Xi subconsciously picked up Han Yue and pointed in the direction of the door.

The young teacher's voice came from outside the door: "Classmate, are you in there?"

As soon as she heard the voice of a young teacher, Lin Xi walked out. The young teacher looked at Lin Xi walking out and said, "Hello, classmate, I am a teacher who has just transferred to our school. My name is Sun Yue. How about you?"

Lin Xi was stunned when she heard the name and then asked: "What did you say your name was?"

Sun Yue looked at Lin Xi and replied in confusion: "My name is Sun Yue, what's wrong?" "What two words are they?" "Sun Tzu's Art of War, Joyful Yue."

Lin Xi looked at the extremely sweet-looking young teacher in front of her in disbelief, because in the previous life, in the Yanhuang base, the largest base in China, there were the Five Emperors and Three Emperors as the biggest backers of the base. It was rumored that the five emperors were all S-level ability users, while the Three Emperors were S+ level ability users. According to legend, Ice Emperor Sun Yue, one of the three emperors, was infinitely close to the SS level and was called the head of the three emperors.

Lin Xi never expected that the Ice Emperor Sun Yue, the leader of the Three Emperors, would actually be a teacher in his school.What was even more unexpected was that the system actually asked Lin Xi to take her into his camp.

Lin Xi waited for a long time before saying, "It's okay, it's okay. My name is Lin Xi, and I'm a student in Class 2, Grade 3."

Sun Yue nodded and said, "Then let's go now?" "Well, let's go."

After that, the two of them quietly walked to the third floor. When they arrived at the third floor, they found that there was not a single zombie on the third floor. Lin Xi didn't hear any sound. Sun Yue said, "How can it be empty?" Lin Xi shook her head and said, "I don't know. I always feel like something is wrong." After he paused, he suddenly thought of something.

In Lin Xi's mind: "I'm so stupid, how could I forget this."
